source.author: lucan
source.text: Coeli iste fretique, Non puppis nostrae labor est: hanc Caesare pressam A fluctu defendet onus.
source.text_original: Coeli iste fretique, / Non puppis nostrae labor est: hanc Caesare pressam / A fluctu defendet onus.
source.text_english: That sky and sea are no burden on this ship of ours: the load, pressed down by Caesar, will protect it from the wave.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: illumetu tantum non indignantibus undis hoc caput accipias et pressam regibus alnum.
reuse.text_original: †illumetu tantum / non indignantibus undis / hoc caput accipias et pressam regibus alnum.
reuse.text_english: may you receive this head, the waves almost not indignant, and the alder-tree, pressed down by kings.
